reason: The spec sheet, UL numbers and free returns are what I look for, but 2 to 3 weeks delivery with my electrician back in three weeks leaves no slack if it slips or the size is wrong. I will not hang my kitchen schedule on a store I have never heard of.
objection: If it arrives late or I have to return it, the electrician is already gone and I am paying for a second visit; the 10% back for lateness does not cover that. And I cannot yet check the UL number or find real reviews for this store.
would_change_my_mind: A firm ship-by date guaranteed in writing at least a week before my electrician comes, or stock that ships in a few days, plus a UL listing number I can verify and a few verified reviews with photos.
